title: Unit 2: Key Vocabulary & Terminology (Part 1) 🏃‍♂️
content: 📌 Welcome Freshmen Students to Communicative English Skills I (EnLa101)! 👋✨ Here is the essential vocabulary list for Unit 2: Health and Fitness, formatted clearly for study and exam preparation. 1. Career (Noun) • English: An occupation undertaken for a significant period of a person's life with opportunities for progress. • Amharic: የሥራ መስመር / ሙያዊ ጉዞ • Synonyms: Profession, Occupation • Antonyms: Hobby, Pastime • Example: Zinedine Zidane had an outstanding career as a professional football player. 2. Profession (Noun) • English: A paid occupation, especially one that involves prolonged training and a formal qualification. • Amharic: ሙያ • Synonyms: Vocation, Career • Antonyms: Avocation, Hobby • Example: Teaching is a respected profession that requires continuous learning. 3. Professional (Adjective / Noun) • English: Relating to or belonging to a profession; engaged in a specified activity as one's main paid occupation. • Amharic: ባለሙያ / ፕሮፌሽናል • Synonyms: Expert, Experienced • Antonyms: Amateur, Unskilled • Example: He became a professional athlete after winning the national championship. 4. Achievements (Noun) • English: Things done successfully, typically by effort, courage, or skill. • Amharic: ስኬቶች / የሥራ ውጤቶች • Synonyms: Accomplishments, Successes • Antonyms: Failures, Defeats • Example: Breaking the world record was one of her greatest athletic achievements.

title: Unit 2: Key Vocabulary & Terminology (Part 2) 🏋️‍♂️
content: 📌 5. Crowd (Noun) • English: A large number of people gathered together in a disorganized or crowded way. • Amharic: የሰዎች ስብስብ / ህዝብ • Synonyms: Gathering, Multitude, Assembly • Antonyms: Individual, Isolation • Example: The football player waved to the cheering crowd in the stadium. 6. Jog (Verb / Noun) • English: Run at a steady, gentle pace, especially as a form of physical exercise. • Amharic: ቀስ ብሎ መሮጥ (ለአካል ብቃት እንቅስቃሴ) • Synonyms: Trot, Run slowly • Antonyms: Sprint, Dash • Example: I usually jog in the park every morning to maintain good fitness. 7. Benefit (Noun / Verb) • English: An advantage or profit gained from something; to receive an advantage. • Amharic: ጥቅም / መጠቀም • Synonyms: Advantage, Profit, Gain • Antonyms: Disadvantage, Harm, Loss • Example: Engaging in daily physical exercise brings immense health benefits. 8. Ultimate (Adjective) • English: Being or happening at the end of a process; final or most important. • Amharic: የመጨረሻ / ዋና • Synonyms: Final, Supreme, Primary • Antonyms: Initial, Beginning • Example: The ultimate goal of playing team sports is to build collaboration and stay healthy. --- ❤️ Dear EthioFresh Students! All vocabulary terms for Unit 2 are now complete. Practice these words for your reading comprehension and vocabulary exam questions! 🙏✨
